page.overview:
What is Espeon?

Espeon is a -type Pokémon who appears in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Gates to Infinity Animated Trailer (Part 2).

Espeon, along with Umbreon, used her own power to open the Magnagate, a portal to distant, secret dungeons. Along with other Pokémon, Espeon went through the portal and was transported in an icy chamber. However, during the adventure, Espeon, along with other Pokémon except Oshawott, fell down, unconscious.

None of Espeon's moves are known. Category:Psychic-type anime Pokémon Category:Female anime Pokémon Category:"Pokémon that can Talk" Category:Mystery Dungeon characters
